queries.aggregate: SELECT * FROM strategy_perf_by_class WHERE asset_class='CRYPTO' AND strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
queries.outcome_status:
SELECT strategy,asset_class,status,COUNT(*) n,
        SUM(pnl_pct>0) positive,SUM(pnl_pct<0) negative,SUM(pnl_pct=0) zero,
        SUM(pnl_pct IS NULL) null_pnl, SUM(pnl_pct) pnl_sum,
        SUM(IF(pnl_pct>0,pnl_pct,0)) gp,SUM(IF(pnl_pct<0,-pnl_pct,0)) gl,
        MIN(resolved_at) first_resolved,MAX(resolved_at) last_resolved,
        COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) symbols
        FROM at_pick_outcomes WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) GROUP BY strategy,asset_class,status
queries.outcome_provenance:
SELECT strategy,resolver_version,resolution_method,
        forward_validated,forward_test_only,_gated_forward_test_isolated,
        COUNT(*) n, SUM(pnl_pct>0) positive,SUM(pnl_pct<0) negative,
        MIN(resolved_at) first_resolved,MAX(resolved_at) last_resolved
        FROM at_pick_outcomes WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
        GROUP BY strategy,resolver_version,resolution_method,forward_validated,
        forward_test_only,_gated_forward_test_isolated
queries.raw_status:
SELECT strategy,source_system,status,COUNT(*) n,
        COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) symbols,COUNT(DISTINCT dedup_hash) unique_hashes,
        SUM(was_stale=1) stale_flagged,MIN(signal_timestamp) first_signal,
        MAX(signal_timestamp) last_signal,MIN(closed_at) first_closed,
        MAX(closed_at) last_closed,SUM(pnl_pct>0) positive,SUM(pnl_pct<0) negative,
        SUM(pnl_pct) pnl_sum,MAX(recorded_at) last_recorded
        FROM at_raw_picks WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) GROUP BY strategy,source_system,status
queries.signal_status:
SELECT strategy,source_system,outcome,intrabar_status,
        COUNT(*) n, SUM(pnl_pct>0) positive,SUM(pnl_pct<0) negative,
        SUM(pnl_pct) pnl_sum,SUM(IF(pnl_pct>0,pnl_pct,0)) gp,
        SUM(IF(pnl_pct<0,-pnl_pct,0)) gl,
        SUM(intrabar_pnl_pct>0) ib_positive,SUM(intrabar_pnl_pct<0) ib_negative,
        SUM(intrabar_pnl_pct) ib_sum,
        SUM(IF(intrabar_pnl_pct>0,intrabar_pnl_pct,0)) ib_gp,
        SUM(IF(intrabar_pnl_pct<0,-intrabar_pnl_pct,0)) ib_gl,
        SUM(intrabar_ambiguous=1) ambiguous,MIN(opened_at) first_opened,
        MAX(opened_at) last_opened,MIN(closed_at) first_closed,
        MAX(closed_at) last_closed,MAX(intrabar_resolved_at) last_ib_resolved
        FROM at_signal_outcomes WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
        GROUP BY strategy,source_system,outcome,intrabar_status
queries.outcome_shared_resolution:
SELECT strategy,DATE(resolved_at) resolved_day,
        COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT resolved_at) distinct_close_times,
        COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) symbols,COUNT(DISTINCT pnl_pct) distinct_pnls
        FROM at_pick_outcomes WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) AND status IN ('WON','LOST')
        GROUP BY strategy,DATE(resolved_at)
queries.raw_repeated_economic_entries:
SELECT strategy,COUNT(*) duplicate_groups,
        SUM(n) rows_in_groups,MAX(n) max_repeats
        FROM (SELECT strategy,symbol,direction,entry_price,take_profit,stop_loss,
        COUNT(*) n FROM at_raw_picks WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
        GROUP BY strategy,symbol,direction,entry_price,take_profit,stop_loss
        HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d GROUP BY strategy
queries.signal_repeated_economic_entries:
SELECT strategy,COUNT(*) duplicate_groups,
        SUM(n) rows_in_groups,MAX(n) max_repeats
        FROM (SELECT strategy,symbol,direction,entry_price,take_profit,stop_loss,
        COUNT(*) n FROM at_signal_outcomes WHERE strategy IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
        GROUP BY strategy,symbol,direction,entry_price,take_profit,stop_loss
        HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d GROUP BY strategy
